project.name: issuemesh
project.description: IssueMesh is an autonomous local-first issue intelligence engine that federates issues, discussions, tasks, and code reviews across Launchpad, GitHub, and Jira with deep graph expansion and hybrid ranking.

interfaces.name: network
interfaces.reason: Allows outbound network access to query GitHub, Jira, and Launchpad APIs as well as LLM endpoints.

interfaces.name: network-bind
interfaces.reason: Allows binding to network ports (default 8765) to serve the Web UI and REST API.

interfaces.name: home
interfaces.reason: Allows access to user configuration or migration files in the user home directory.

notes: Under Snap strict confinement, IssueMesh stores database, cache, and configuration in $SNAP_USER_COMMON by default.
Zero external dynamic dependencies on libssl or libsqlite3 (uses pure Rustls and bundled SQLite).
